title: PrincipalRef
description: Identity reference for creators, issuers, revokers and grantees. Semantics owned by the Nexus identity plane. subject_id and trust_domain are NOT credentials.

subject_id.description: Opaque identity; consumers do not parse its structure.

trust_domain.description: Optional trust-domain qualifier; not a credential.

$comment: additionalProperties stays true: unknown optional fields are accepted and ignored under a supported major.
